Latin word

cadō

cadō, cadere, cecidī, cāsum

verb, third conjugation, intransitive

fail, fall flat (of a play); fail (an exam); fall; fail, lose (a case, a contest); turn out, fall out (well, as one wished)

In this lexicon

    also used · classical · Hor. Epist. 2.1.176: sēcūrus cadat an rēctō stet fābula tālō; Traupman 312: in exāmine cadere

  • fall

    the recommended word · classical

  • lose

    also used · classical · Cic. Inv. 2.57: causā cadere; Andresian p. 20

  • turn out well

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Att. 3.7.1: sānē ita cadēbat ut vellem (Lewis & Short); Cic. Fam. 5.19.1: cum aliter rēs cecidisset ac putāssēs (Lewis & Short)
